name: Cloudflare peer routing
description: Plan explicit peer-ID DNS inclusion and exclusion while preserving unmanaged records (typed contracts 1.0: FlatBuffers only). plan reads the complete Cloudflare DNS listing (HttpResponse pages), the known peers ($NST) and the node's publication verifications ($PNV), with operator choices from node config (plugin.getConfig: cloudflare_zone_id, cloudflare_zone_name, cloudflare_api_base, request_timeout_ms, peers [{peer_id, included, origin_ipv4, origin_verified, public_artifacts_only}], managed_records [{label, record_id}]), and emits the Cloudflare API calls as HttpRequests (CONTEXT one $APR naming peer and action) plus one FlowNotice per peer. It never holds credentials or executes them; the credentialed host applies and re-reads.

methods.description: DNS listing pages + $NST + $PNV + config -> POST/PUT/DELETE dns_records HttpRequests and per-peer FlowNotices. Snapshot time is the latest page RETRIEVED_MS. A peer is verified when a $PNV entry it published has SIGNATURE_VERIFIED with KEY_SOURCE IdentityRecord, PeerIdentifier or OperatorTrust, received within 900 s. Undeclared $NST peers are excluded; only explicit exclusion deletes an owned route.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpResponse (HRSP) from hostcap/http-request for GET <api>/zones/<zone>/dns_records: STATUS 200, BODY Cloudflare's JSON listing (success, result, result_info page/total_pages/total_count), RETRIEVED_MS the snapshot time.

inputPorts.description: Every page of the zone's DNS listing (pages 1..total_pages exactly once).

acceptedTypeSets.description: $NST: the peers the node knows (hostcap/p2p-discovery peers_snapshot).

inputPorts.description: Discovered peers; discovery alone creates no route.

acceptedTypeSets.description: $PNV: the node's verdicts on received publication notices.

inputPorts.description: Peer identity verification and its time.

acceptedTypeSets.description: HttpRequest (HREQ): POST <api>/zones/<zone>/dns_records, PUT or DELETE .../dns_records/<id>; BODY (POST/PUT) the Cloudflare JSON record {type A, name, content, proxied true, ttl 1, comment sdn-peer:<label>}; no authorization header (the credentialed host adds it); CONTEXT one size-prefixed $APR (METHOD, PATH, ROUTE cloudflare-dns-record, PARAMETERS peerId/label/hostname/recordId).

outputPorts.description: Planned Cloudflare API calls; not applied.

acceptedTypeSets.description: FlowNotice (FNTC) per peer: PROVIDER_ID cloudflare, SOURCE_NAME hostname, BATCH_ID peer id, REASON included/excluded/blocked/conflict/pending-inclusion/pending-exclusion, KIND Unchanged (included) / Info (pending-*) / Skipped (the rest), COUNT 1 when included, ITEMS the message and "cache-purge-required", AT_MS the snapshot time.

sequentialJustification.detail: Bounded deterministic DNS comparison and identity encoding; one plugin.getConfig hostcall, no workers or network access inside this planning method.
